notes: Townsfolk, caravan and story character name labels cost less with many players around.
Expedition dungeons build in shorter steps, so a busy server no longer hitches while one is built.
resourceNotes: Easy Building's resources: line endings tidied (no change for players).

town_bp.notes: A mayor per town, building spots the town picks and levels gently (at most 3 blocks, never your blocks), houses, paths, lantern posts, a garden pen whose animals come back if they wander off, and villagers who move in (Enabled), never take beds or harvest crops, and come home when they stray.

npc_bp.notes: Town mayors: each town can have its own mayor who takes deliveries for that town; mayors share town news. Townsfolk name labels cost less with many players near.

welcome_bp.notes: The welcome page lists Town Projects: towns that grow as you help, each with its mayor.

admin_bp.notes: The setup checklist says towns pick their own project spots, so setting one is optional, and a spot an operator sets is never leveled.

silly_bp.notes: Cheaper on busy servers: nothing runs every tick unless someone wears Hyper Jump boots or is mid-flight.

caravan_bp.notes: Internal: the name label sync reads less (shared name-labels module).

saga_bp.notes: Internal: the story characters' name label sync reads less (shared name-labels module).

wander_bp.notes: Internal: shared name-labels module update (no change for wanderers).

expedition_bp.notes: Dungeon builds and resets spread their work over more, shorter steps: no build step holds a server tick for long.
